poc_scope: 4-week Dedicated POC: 1) Provision small Dedicated pool in us-east and us-west regions. 2) Run canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with monitoring windows. 3) Implement fallback routing: model-variant route (quantized smaller model) + region failover (sticky sessions TTL 24h). 4) Run load tests (target 200 req/s sustained), latency SLOs p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms. 5) Run quality regressions vs eval set (redwood eval harness).
acceptance_criteria: Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms under target load; Throughput: sustained 200 req/s with autoscale; Regression: no more than 3% drop on relevance metrics vs hosted baseline; Operational: VPC private control plane verified, audit logs ingested into customer SIEM, SAML SSO complete.
canary_plan: Start at 5% production traffic (2 days), check latency/cost/error-rate. Increase to 25% (48h), validate KV cache hit rate and memory usage. At 25% run a synthetic regression suite each 12h. If any critical metric breaches, automated rollback to prior model-version and traffic backfilled to hosted fallback.
fallback_routing_notes: Primary: curated base model (redwood-medic-3b) on Dedicated; Fallback 1: quantized variant (redwood-medic-3b-4bit) same region; Fallback 2: region failover to us-west pools with model-pin compatibility; Final fallback: Hosted API read-only endpoint for non-sensitive low-volume traffic. Ensure session affinity for chat (sticky key hashing) to preserve KV cache benefits.
rollback_and_runbook: Rollback is automated via the rollout controller: pin previous model-version, shift canary traffic to 0% in two steps, and trigger alert to SE + customer CISO. Customer requested documented SLA for rollback time <= 5 minutes in case of severe regression. Redwood SE to provide runbook and playbook examples (RED-1143).
